contexts.text: Those of them who correspond to the less vital viscid phlegm, keep the thought intent on these anxieties.
In the light of Heaven [they appear] like phlegm, with very little interior life.
6. 2. The blood of the heart is dephlegmated in the lungs... The quality of the dephlegmation and nutrition of the blood in the lungs with the good, and with the evil. Explained.
